purpose: Give a named agent builder one concrete reason to try Witness.
shared_instruction: Send the exact JSON to POST /quote. Pay POST /witness only after 200 can_deliver:true. Then POST /witness again with the identical bytes. Two $0.01 settlements, two receipts, one spec_hash. Do not change url, extract, assertion, or replicas between pays.

cards.message: Can your agent use a signed current ranking instead of trusting a scraped list?
Need a timestamped public price with evidence? Try this bounded BTC-USD observation.
Need an attributable stock check before your agent acts? Quote this public catalog item.
Need to know which package release is published right now? Ask Witness for a signed version card.
Need evidence that a public record exists before chaining another action? Quote this bounded lookup.

rules: Do not record wallet, IP, URL, evidence, or payment headers in outreach logs.
